RA L-side test is compared to Normal-R instead of Normal-L.
Overall RA judgement cannot be simply improved; R improves slightly while L worsens vs its own baseline.
Normal-L row is cited but omitted from RA comparison rows and subresults.
Function-check rows appear descriptive or separate; their link to the changed factor is not proven.
requiredUserQuestions: Confirm whether R/L are side subgroups and not separate changed factors.
correctionPlan: Rewrite changed factor as Normal vs test unit OK hearing D3 moved RA.
Create separate R and L subgroup comparisons using matched Normal-R and Normal-L baselines.
Set RA judgement to mixed or not_judged, not improved.
Include Test!24 in RA comparison rows and L-side subresult.
Treat function-check rows as contextual/descriptive unless comparable conditions are clear.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are insufficient until matched baselines and headers are corrected.
